blocks.content: Quiz: What happens when the value inside a Context Provider changes?
Tap an option below to answer:
All components that called useContext() with that context object re-render with the new value
useContext() creates a subscription. When the Provider's value updates, every subscriber re-renders.
useContext() creates a subscription. When the Provider's value updates, every subscriber re-renders.
The entire app re-renders from the root, including components not using context
React only re-renders the components that are subscribed to that context.
React only re-renders the components that are subscribed to that context.
Only the component that called toggleTheme() re-renders
toggleTheme() lives in the Provider. The component calling it re-renders, but that's not the full picture.
toggleTheme() lives in the Provider. The component calling it re-renders, but that's not the full picture.
Nothing happens until the user navigates to a new page
Context updates are reactive and immediate, no navigation needed.
Context updates are reactive and immediate, no navigation needed.
